title: L¹ translation estimates pass to L¹ limits
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, every a.e.-strongly measurable F : ℝⁿ → ℝ, every sequence (w_j)_{j∈ℕ} of a.e.-strongly measurable functions ℝⁿ → ℝ with ∫⁻_{ℝⁿ} ‖w_j(x) − F(x)‖ₑ dx → 0 as j → ∞, every set Q ⊆ ℝⁿ (no measurability assumed), every z ∈ ℝⁿ and every C ∈ [0,∞]: if ∫⁻_Q ‖w_j(x − z) − w_j(x)‖ₑ dx ≤ C for every j, then ∫⁻_Q ‖F(x − z) − F(x)‖ₑ dx ≤ C. Here ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) with Lebesgue measure volume, and all integrals are lower Lebesgue integrals in [0,∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Rn n → ℝ) (w : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (Q : Set (Rn n)) (z : Rn n) (C : ℝ≥0∞), AEStronglyMeasurable F volume → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (w j) volume) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∫⁻ x, ‖w j x - F x‖ₑ) atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ j, ∫⁻ x in Q, ‖w j (x - z) - w j x‖ₑ ≤ C) → ∫⁻ x in Q, ‖F (x - z) - F x‖ₑ ≤ C
